# SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 Scientific-Owner Freeze

> asking whether SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 should become the complete scientific
> authority and be frozen, superseding r0.4 while retaining r0.4 provenance.

Normalized freeze directive:

## Frozen Authority

This owner statement promotes the verified candidate at commit
`8f0ecccfacbdce0543141c4289ec06c702065f5e`
without scientific change. It freezes SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 as the active
scientific authority for:

- the standalone science-team rationale and the six-file shared normative
  core;
- the engineering conformance view, whose view-specific guidance is
  informative and introduces no independent normative science;
- the approved `WP1-OWNER-D001--D009`, `PTC-OWNER-Q001--Q003`, and retained
  scope/review decisions;
- the 38 author decisions and 15-entry detailed owner ledger;
- the exact 159-row requirement/prediction crosswalk; and
- the two canonical frozen PDF renderings recorded in `pdf/README.md`.

The frozen inventory is 45 definitions, 25 numbered equations, 35
assumptions, 99 requirements, and 60 predictions. The five decided, three
open, four known-but-not-supplied, and three deferred detailed-ledger states
retain their exact meanings and consequences.

## Supersession And Claim Boundary

R0.5 supersedes r0.4 as the active scientific authority. The r0.4 freeze,
source, and PDF identities remain recoverable from their exact record and
immutable Git history; they are not silently reinterpreted as r0.5.

This freeze does not close `F-001`, `F-002`, `F-009`, or `F-011`. It supplies
the successor authority required for their later clean-room re-audit and
closure disposition. It does not assert implementation conformity,
representation fidelity, validation, observational performance, science
qualification, MAP availability, default activation, production readiness,
or production promotion.

## Change Control

The freeze promotion is status-only. It changes no approved candidate
definition, equation, assumption, requirement, prediction, owner-ledger state,
scientific meaning, or unavailable-state consequence. Any future substantive
correction, resolved open choice, or changed scientific boundary requires
explicit owner authority and a versioned successor or formally reopened
revision. Frozen r0.5 authority must not be silently edited.
